BCAS Delhi Guest Faculty Selection Process 2026
Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for BCAS Delhi Guest Faculty Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the post name for the BCAS Delhi recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is for the post of Guest Faculty at Bhaskaracharya College of Applied Sciences.

faq.question: Q2. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode is Walk-in. Candidates need to attend the interview in person.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is scheduled for 05-09-2026.

faq.question: Q4. What are the eligibility criteria for the Guest Faculty post?
faq.answer: Eligibility is the same as prescribed for regular assistant professors as per UGC regulations and adopted by the University of Delhi.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any age limit for the candidates?
faq.answer: Yes, superannuated teachers up to 70 years of age can be considered.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary or honorarium for the Guest Faculty?
faq.answer: The honorarium will be paid as per UGC norms.

faq.question: Q7. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Carry all original certificates, self-attested photocopies, and passport-size photographs.

faq.question: Q8. Where is the venue for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The interview will be held at Bhaskaracharya College of Applied Sciences, New Delhi - 110075.

faq.question: Q9. What is the job type for this Guest Faculty position?
faq.answer: The job type is Contractual.

faq.question: Q10. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No application fee is mentioned in the official notification for this recruitment.
